run_structure_generator_cli: run the structure generator CLI to create adsorbate slab placements with vasp input files
run_precompute_slabs: run the precompute_slabs function to generate and save slab surfaces for a given bulk index
run_parse_args: run parse_args to validate and return command line arguments for the structure generator
run_run_placements: run the run_placements function to generate adsorbate placements for a single adsorbate bulk surface triplet
run_write_surface: run write_surface to generate vasp input files and metadata for a slab surface
